tests.id: MFA-BACKUP-CODE-FORMAT-001
tests.title: MFA backup codes generated in incomplete format are rejected during login recovery
tests.error: Backup codes generated/downloaded in format XXXX-XXXX- are rejected by the MFA challenge that expects XXXX-XXXX-XX.
tests.businessImpact: Users may be unable to recover access with backup codes if they lose authenticator access.
tests.recommendedInvestigationAction: Review backup-code generation, download/export formatting, storage validation, and MFA challenge validation rules so generated codes match the accepted login format.

tests.id: MFA-GOOGLE-AUTH-PASSWORD-001
tests.title: Google-authenticated users are asked for password when regenerating backup codes or disabling 2FA
tests.error: Google-authenticated user cannot regenerate backup codes or disable 2FA because the flow asks for a password the user does not have.
tests.businessImpact: Google-authenticated users may be unable to manage or recover MFA settings without admin/support intervention.
tests.recommendedInvestigationAction: Update MFA management confirmation for OAuth users to use an OAuth-safe verification method, such as recent login, TOTP confirmation, email verification, or step-up authentication.

tests.id: SIGNUP-OTP-LENGTH-001
tests.title: Signup OTP input accepts more than six digits
tests.error: Signup OTP field does not enforce the six-digit maximum length.
tests.businessImpact: Users can enter invalid OTP values beyond the supported code length, creating confusion and weakening front-end validation quality.
tests.recommendedInvestigationAction: Add a six-digit max-length guard to the signup OTP input and keep submit behavior aligned with the backend OTP validation rules.

release.recommendedAction: Resolve confirmed MFA defects, then rerun the affected MFA scenarios before release approval.

blockers.name: Signup OTP input accepts more than six digits
blockers.reason: Users can enter invalid OTP values beyond the supported code length, creating confusion and weakening front-end validation quality.

requiredActions: Add a six-digit max-length guard to the signup OTP input and keep submit behavior aligned with the backend OTP validation rules.

blockers.name: Signup OTP input accepts more than six digits
blockers.reason: Users can enter invalid OTP values beyond the supported code length, creating confusion and weakening front-end validation quality.

requiredActions: Add a six-digit max-length guard to the signup OTP input and keep submit behavior aligned with the backend OTP validation rules.
releaseDecision.recommendedAction: Resolve confirmed product defects, then rerun the affected scenarios before release approval.
releaseDecision.explanation: AIR recommends NO GO because the restored regression passed, but 1 confirmed product defect(s) remain open.
